description: Constructor standings entries with season-to-date points equal to 6.0 are included in the filter.

a.request: For each race (`constructorStandings.raceId`), using only constructor standings entries whose season-to-date points (`constructorStandings.points`) are at least 6.0, compute the average season-to-date points and the average season-to-date win count (`constructorStandings.wins`), ignoring missing values (an average is missing if there are none). Then take the overall average of these per-race average wins across all races, again ignoring missing values; return nothing if that overall average is missing. List the race ID, average points, average wins, and the race's average wins minus the overall average. Show the 10 races with the largest difference first (missing differences last), without rounding.
a.sql:
WITH per_race AS (
  SELECT raceId,
         AVG(points) AS avg_points,
         AVG(wins) AS avg_wins
  FROM constructorStandings
  WHERE points >= 6.0
  GROUP BY raceId
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS overall_avg_wins
  FROM per_race
)
SELECT p.raceId,
       p.avg_points,
       p.avg_wins,
       p.avg_wins - o.overall_avg_wins AS difference
FROM per_race AS p
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE o.overall_avg_wins IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

c.request: For each race (`constructorStandings.raceId`), using only constructor standings entries whose season-to-date points (`constructorStandings.points`) clear the 6.0-point threshold, compute the average season-to-date points and the average season-to-date win count (`constructorStandings.wins`), ignoring missing values (an average is missing if there are none). Then take the overall average of these per-race average wins across all races, again ignoring missing values; return nothing if that overall average is missing. List the race ID, average points, average wins, and the race's average wins minus the overall average. Show the 10 races with the largest difference first (missing differences last), without rounding. Constructor standings entries with season-to-date points equal to 6.0 are included in the filter.
c.sql:
WITH per_race AS (
  SELECT raceId,
         AVG(CASE WHEN points IS NOT NULL THEN points END) AS avg_points,
         AVG(CASE WHEN wins IS NOT NULL THEN wins END) AS avg_wins
  FROM constructorStandings
  WHERE points >= 6.0
  GROUP BY raceId
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS overall_avg_wins
  FROM per_race
  WHERE avg_wins IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT p.raceId,
       p.avg_points,
       p.avg_wins,
       p.avg_wins - o.overall_avg_wins AS difference
FROM per_race AS p
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE o.overall_avg_wins IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

d.request: For each race, include constructor standings entries with season-to-date points greater than or equal to 6.0; compute their average season-to-date points and wins, ignoring missing values, and omit races with no average wins. Compute the overall average of these per-race average wins, ignoring missing values, then return each race’s ID, average points, average wins, and the difference between its average wins and the overall average. Show the 10 races with the largest differences first, with missing differences last and no rounding.
d.sql:
WITH race_averages AS (
  SELECT
    raceId,
    AVG(points) AS average_points,
    AVG(wins) AS average_wins
  FROM constructorStandings
  WHERE points >= 6.0
  GROUP BY raceId
  HAVING AVG(wins) IS NOT NULL
),
with_differences AS (
  SELECT
    raceId,
    average_points,
    average_wins,
    average_wins - AVG(average_wins) OVER () AS difference
  FROM race_averages
)
SELECT raceId, average_points, average_wins, difference
FROM with_differences
ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

b.request: For each race, include constructor standings entries with season-to-date points greater than or equal to 6.0, then calculate the average season-to-date points and average season-to-date wins, ignoring missing values and leaving an average missing when no values exist. Calculate the overall average of the per-race average wins, ignoring missing values, and return no rows if that overall average is missing. Return each race ID, its average points, average wins, and the difference between its average wins and the overall average; order by difference descending with missing differences last, and return the first 10 races without rounding.
b.sql:
WITH per_race AS (
  SELECT
    raceId,
    AVG(points) AS avg_points,
    AVG(wins) AS avg_wins
  FROM constructorStandings
  WHERE points >= 6.0
  GROUP BY raceId
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS overall_avg_wins
  FROM per_race
)
SELECT
  p.raceId,
  p.avg_points,
  p.avg_wins,
  p.avg_wins - o.overall_avg_wins AS difference
FROM per_race AS p
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE o.overall_avg_wins IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
